source: site/catalog.json (846 entries: title, summary, takeaways, tools, caption, transcript) + guides, content kits, tool hubs, compare pages, data/monetize
method: Keyword and domain scoring narrowed 846 entries to about 300 candidates; summaries and transcripts were read manually; only entries with a concrete, usable method were kept. Ranked within group by tier, then specificity.

a_content_production.title: You can turn Claude Code into a full motion design team on @higgsfield.a...
a_content_production.creator: @jens.heitmann
a_content_production.what_it_teaches: Connect Claude Code to Higgsfield 'using playwright so it can drive the tools like the marketing studio directly', generate stills/3D/avatars with Nano Banana, then install a Seedance 2.0 skill so Claude 'can architect prompts just like a professional'.
a_content_production.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Use for B-roll and cover motion on the 63 content kits (reel_script.md has no visuals yet; only 1 kit has video). Run it from the dejaviewed-content skill as an optional 'render b-roll' step; every rendered clip doubles as a demo for the Higgsfield hub's /go/higgsfield link.

a_content_production.title: Claude isn’t just for coding anymore. I’ve been using it to run full marketing...
a_content_production.creator: @brodyautomates
a_content_production.what_it_teaches: Playwright MCP gives Claude Code browser control, and a skills file teaches it to 'upload reference images, write prompts, pick Seedance 2.0 as the model, and then generate full videos with native audio all on its own'.
a_content_production.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Same pipeline as the entry above, second confirmation. Treat the two as one build: a 'kit-to-reel' skill that turns each kit's hook slide into a 5-10s motion intro. Keep human review before posting.

a_content_production.title: MoneyPrinterTurbo — one-topic-in, finished short video out
a_content_production.creator: @franklim.gui
a_content_production.what_it_teaches: MoneyPrinterTurbo takes a topic, 'writes the script, pulls HD/4K stock footage, adds narration, subtitles and music, and renders vertical or horizontal videos in batches'. Works with Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek, runs locally or in Colab, no watermark.
a_content_production.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Feed each kit's reel_script.md in as the script (skip its own scripting) and batch-render rough vertical drafts for all 63 kits. Use them as drafts only: a talking-head or screen recording will beat stock footage for a tool-review account.

a_content_production.title: Six monetizable AI GitHub repos — clipping, Remotion, OpenHands and more
a_content_production.creator: @raycfu
a_content_production.what_it_teaches: Six repos, each mapped to a sellable service, including 'AutoClip for auto-cutting highlights from long videos' and 'Remotion for templated programmatic video'. 'Remotion turns repetitive video edits into code templates.'
a_content_production.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Remotion fits best: build one React template that turns a kit's slide JSON into an animated 9:16 video with consistent brand motion, rendered for all 63 kits in one batch. AutoClip can cut highlights from any long-form screen recordings later.

a_content_production.title: OpenScreen — free open-source Screen Studio alternative
a_content_production.creator: @marc.kaz
a_content_production.what_it_teaches: OpenScreen is a 'free MIT-licensed screen recorder with auto-zoom on clicks, cursor animations, webcam overlays, any aspect ratio'. The Recordly fork adds native Mac/Windows recording.
a_content_production.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Record 30-45s 9:16 walkthroughs of the site itself (search, a tool hub, a /compare page). These are the most honest product demos for tool-hub reels, and the openscreen-screen-recorder guide already exists to link back to.

a_content_production.title: Humanizer skill for Claude Code — strip AI tells from your writing
a_content_production.creator: @jens.heitmann
a_content_production.what_it_teaches: Build a humanizer skill from blader/humanizer (based on Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing') plus StoryScope structural tells, and 'enforce it with CLAUDE.md rules or hooks, not just an optional skill'.
a_content_production.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Add a de-AI pass to content_kit.py output (captions, slide text) and to guide generation. A hook gate can match the existing rebuild.sh publish gates.

a_content_production.title: StopSlop — a Claude skill file that strips AI writing tells
a_content_production.creator: @therobertta
a_content_production.what_it_teaches: StopSlop bans filler phrases, throat-clearing openers, emphasis crutches and adverbs, but 'deleting tells doesn't add opinion; take a stance yourself. Use AI for the first 80%, edit the last 20% by hand'.
a_content_production.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Pair with the humanizer pass, and have Victor add one hand-written opinion line per caption. That line is the keep/try/skip verdict the brand needs anyway.

a_content_production.title: AI weekly roundup — Pocket TTS, Hermes Skills Hub, Kimi K3 in pure C
a_content_production.creator: @drcintas
a_content_production.what_it_teaches: Kyutai Pocket TTS: '100M-param local voice cloning, 6x real-time', one-command setup.
a_content_production.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Free local fallback for voicing drafts in Victor's own cloned voice when he can't record. Disclose cloned voice, and use the real voice for flagship posts given the retention claim in Dba75DDxiqc.

a_content_production.title: Claude Code content system — seven skills from research to repurposing
a_content_production.creator: @chase.h.ai
a_content_production.what_it_teaches: A creator pipeline split into seven Claude Code skills: source research, a YT-pipeline skill that 'offloads analysis to NotebookLM', competitive ideation, hook/outline/title scripting and repurposing into blogs, X threads and 60-120s shorts; 'distill long videos into new short-form scripts rather than clipping'. Credited with 90 pieces in 30 days.
a_content_production.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Map this onto the existing dejaviewed-content skill: it already has scripting and kits, so add the missing 'repurpose' stage (each guide becomes carousel + X thread + LinkedIn post + short). The guides are the long-form source to distill.

a_content_production.title: Higgsfield Cinema Studio — directing AI video with camera and lens controls
a_content_production.creator: @nateherkai
a_content_production.what_it_teaches: Higgsfield Cinema Studio: 'specify camera move, lens and mood explicitly in video prompts' (e.g. rainy interrogation, slow zoom). Use AI scenes for previs and ad prototypes.
a_content_production.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Put a camera/lens/mood field in the reel b-roll prompt template so generated intros look consistent across the series.

a_content_production.title: Ad Deconstruction with GPT-4o — reverse-engineer a winning ad, regenerate for your brand
a_content_production.creator: @thesocialalpha_
a_content_production.what_it_teaches: Upload a competitor ad and have ChatGPT break down 'psychology, imagery, typography, color and composition' before adapting it. 'Copy the reasoning behind an ad rather than the ad itself.'
a_content_production.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Before freezing the kit slide template, run the breakdown on the 5 best-performing carousels from creators in the corpus (@chase.h.ai, @nateherkai). Then adapt the reasoning, not the look.

a_content_production.title: Self-study pipeline — saved links to AI-generated study guides and quizzes
a_content_production.creator: @angus.sewell
a_content_production.what_it_teaches: Log every save in one table, then have an agent 'group recent saves by topic and generate study guides and quizzes', optionally via NotebookLM, for active recall.
a_content_production.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: DejaViewed already is that table. Generate a 5-question quiz carousel per guide ('Did you actually learn what you saved?'), which brings comment engagement and a reason to visit the guide.

a_content_production.title: #ai #claude #marketing #videoediting #vibecoding
a_content_production.creator: @eddynthings
a_content_production.what_it_teaches: A Claude video-editing skill was given only 'create an attractive summary for our memory community repo on GitHub'. It 'went and searched the blogs, the repo for information' and produced intro, cards, animation and closing.
a_content_production.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Point the same kind of skill at the dejaviewed GitHub repo for a launch/promo video of the open-source skill. The specific skill isn't named, so look for it before building one.

a_content_production.title: Faceless horror channel pipeline — AI agent sourcing, human voice and edit
a_content_production.creator: @angus.sewell
a_content_production.what_it_teaches: Argues against fully-AI faceless channels: 'AI voiceover hurts retention, real narrators win'. Use agents for sourcing and admin, keep the creative voice human.
a_content_production.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Victor should voice the reels himself, and keep AI for b-roll and captions. Content kits already script the words; recording 63 voiceovers is about one afternoon of batching.

b_social_growth_tactics.title: If you are also tryna rip a few influencer deals comment “in
b_social_growth_tactics.creator: @angus.sewell
b_social_growth_tactics.what_it_teaches: For UGC/affiliate content: 'scrape and transcribe every single one of their posts, first three sentences and the overall concept and structure of the video, make sure you get the analytics too', put it in a database and have the agent propose concepts. The hard part is getting a good video made.
b_social_growth_tactics.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Same method on our own corpus: the database exists, so add a 'first three sentences + structure' column to the catalog build and use it when writing kit hooks.

b_social_growth_tactics.title: You can make Claude Code your Social Media Manager that studies your cha...
b_social_growth_tactics.creator: @jens.heitmann
b_social_growth_tactics.what_it_teaches: Apify MCP plus Claude Code downloads and transcribes all your own posts, identifies 'trends, phrases, and scripts that people connect with and those that they do not', and simulates how new content will land.
b_social_growth_tactics.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Turn this on after about 20 posts are live: weekly scrape of @dejaviewed's own posts and metrics, compared against the hook templates, feeding the next-7 queue.

b_social_growth_tactics.title: Claude — 1. Prompt for viral content
b_social_growth_tactics.creator: @milamarksonofficial
b_social_growth_tactics.what_it_teaches: Seven copy prompts, including: pain point into 'a hook of up to 10 words', a 30s reel structure ('1) Irresistible hook, 2) Short engaging story, 3) CTA to comment or save'), carousel tips 'a maximum of 12 words' that are 'impossible not to save', and repurposing one text into 'a 7-second Reels script, a 5-slide carousel, a static post'.
b_social_growth_tactics.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Bake these constraints into scripts/content_templates: 10-word hook cap on slide 1, 12-word cap per tip slide, a save/comment CTA on the last slide, and a 7-second reel variant per kit.

b_social_growth_tactics.title: There is a free app putting artists work in front of people  — Instagram shows your work to people who already follow...
b_social_growth_tactics.creator: @creativeflairhq
b_social_growth_tactics.what_it_teaches: Use Pinterest as a search engine: a business account, 'pin your work as tall, high quality images', 'write every caption like a search', 'link every pin back to where people can buy or contact you', and 'five a week beats 50 a day'. One pin can send people to your work for years.
b_social_growth_tactics.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: The 549 kit slides and 846 share cards are tall, finished images. Pin 5 a week with search-phrased captions ('Claude Code hooks examples') linking to the guide or entry. This is the most evergreen, lowest-effort distribution in the corpus.

b_social_growth_tactics.title: The data is all there for you to 10x your growth
b_social_growth_tactics.creator: @tenfoldmarc
b_social_growth_tactics.what_it_teaches: A 'spy' skill pulls a competitor's last 50 posts, finds outliers ('posts that have five times their average views'), transcribes the hook and on-screen text, and turns each into a fill-in-the-blank hook template with why it works.
b_social_growth_tactics.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: DejaViewed already has 846 transcripts from the exact niche. Run the hook-extraction half offline now: first 1-2 sentences per transcript into hooks.json, clustered into templates. Add the outlier half once view counts are scraped (the catalog has no view data).

b_social_growth_tactics.title: it wasn’t some magic funnel, secret strategy, or cute little — it came down to 3 things:
b_social_growth_tactics.creator: @losilver_
b_social_growth_tactics.what_it_teaches: Be 'known, loved, trusted, in that order'. Known means consistency ('every single day across one platform to start'); 'master one, then move to the rest'. Loved means being polarizing ('loved or hated, never tolerated'). Trusted means being genuinely the best at the thing.
b_social_growth_tactics.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Pick Instagram only, post daily from the 63-kit backlog, and give every post an explicit keep/try/skip verdict. The neutral 'here's a tool' framing is what this warns against. Delay TikTok and YouTube until IG cadence holds for 30 days.

b_social_growth_tactics.title: NotebookLM channel analysis — reverse-engineer a YouTube channel's hooks
b_social_growth_tactics.creator: @nateherkai
b_social_growth_tactics.what_it_teaches: Load 10-15 videos from a channel you admire into NotebookLM and ask why they work: topics, hooks, patterns. Build the next video from one idea and 'test one idea at a time, then scale what works'.
b_social_growth_tactics.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Load the transcripts of the 3 most-saved creators in the corpus (@chase.h.ai, @nateherkai, @angus.sewell) as NotebookLM sources to pick the reel format for tool-hub reviews.

b_social_growth_tactics.title: Per the usual if you comment “content” I’ll send you the gui
b_social_growth_tactics.creator: @angus.sewell
b_social_growth_tactics.what_it_teaches: An autonomous carousel agent: a skill that 'scrapes and saves viral instagram posts', one that 'rewrites them as instagram carousel script', one that generates the carousel and one that posts on a schedule. The creator's own verdict: 'your best chance of this working is copying other people'.
b_social_growth_tactics.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: DejaViewed has steps 1-3 already (saves, kits, slides). Add scheduling, but keep a human approval step. The differentiator is curation and verdicts, not volume, which is also the warning in this post.

b_social_growth_tactics.title: Clipper outreach agent — Roy Lee's pay-per-view clipping army, automated
b_social_growth_tactics.creator: @angus.sewell
b_social_growth_tactics.what_it_teaches: Automates the Cluely clipping tactic: an agent finds accounts your audience follows, scrapes suggested clipping accounts, pulls bio emails and pitches them with 'raw footage plus proven examples'. Clippers are paid per view.
b_social_growth_tactics.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Later-stage, once there is long-form footage (live builds). Payouts run about $1-1.50 per thousand views per DadfHYrkmr7, so it needs budget. Park until a YouTube long-form exists.

c_automation_pipelines.title: 7 must-install Claude Code repos — Obsidian Skills, n8n-MCP, Superpowers
c_automation_pipelines.creator: @chase.h.ai
c_automation_pipelines.what_it_teaches: Seven Claude Code repos with links, including czlonkowski/n8n-mcp ('install n8n-MCP for Claude-driven n8n workflows') and nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill.
c_automation_pipelines.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Install n8n-mcp so Claude Code can author the posting and repurposing workflows below instead of hand-building them in the n8n UI. The n8n tool hub already has /go/n8n.

c_automation_pipelines.title: Jarvis daily brief — Claude with RevenueCat, Buffer, Meta Ads and Gmail MCPs
c_automation_pipelines.creator: @chandlerintelligence
c_automation_pipelines.what_it_teaches: A Claude 'Jarvis' with MCP servers for 'RevenueCat, Buffer, Meta Ads and Gmail', custom subagents with their own skills, 'FAQs in markdown' so Claude handles most support email, and the daily brief run as a scheduled routine.
c_automation_pipelines.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Build a DejaViewed daily brief: Cloudflare path analytics (/go/ clicks, top pages), the next-7 post queue, and Buffer for scheduling. Add a FAQ.md for service inquiries arriving through /go/service.

c_automation_pipelines.title: Self-improving startup — Loom transcripts to Claude skills to scheduled tasks
c_automation_pipelines.creator: @angus.sewell
c_automation_pipelines.what_it_teaches: Do each process by hand and record it on Loom; 'the transcript becomes the skill spec'. Run skills supervised 'until they stop failing, then schedule them'. Skills log their own issues and a fixer skill improves the others.
c_automation_pipelines.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Record Victor doing one full posting cycle (pick kit, edit caption, post, credit creator, log status) and turn it into the posting skill. Schedule it only after 5 clean supervised runs.

c_automation_pipelines.title: n8n AI Automation — self-hosted Zapier with AI agent nodes
c_automation_pipelines.creator: @6ab3
c_automation_pipelines.what_it_teaches: n8n as self-hosted Zapier with AI agent nodes, covering 'AI-powered LinkedIn content pipelines, email summarizers, lead enrichment, content repurposing', with Docker setup, LinkedIn API configuration and example JSON workflows.
c_automation_pipelines.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Use the LinkedIn pipeline as the template for cross-posting each guide's 'In short' answer to LinkedIn. That platform is one of the UGC sources answer engines cite, per DaEH4BJMxRX.

c_automation_pipelines.title: Claude Code Meta ads pipeline — Arcads API, Ads MCP and an Airtable swipe file
c_automation_pipelines.creator: @mr.paidsocial
c_automation_pipelines.what_it_teaches: Claude Code launches Meta ads via the Arcads API and Meta Ads MCP, with 'a database of proven ads as reference, not just a brief', '~20 questions about your offer' first, and new ads cloned from an existing ad ID 'so uploads don't break targeting'.
c_automation_pipelines.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Only for a later paid test boosting the best-performing organic carousel to the /go/service page. Hard budget caps are required, per Db36X9ZypwK. Skip until organic has a winner.

c_automation_pipelines.title: Karpathy-style LLM knowledge base — Claude Code turns 36 videos into a linked wiki
c_automation_pipelines.creator: @nateherkai
c_automation_pipelines.what_it_teaches: Following Karpathy's LLM-knowledge-base post, Claude Code ingested 36 YouTube videos, extracted tools/techniques/skills per source 'so hubs emerge naturally', and kept 'source links in each node so the wiki stays verifiable'.
c_automation_pipelines.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: This describes DejaViewed at 846 sources. Use it as positioning: 'Karpathy's LLM wiki, applied to 846 saves, open-source.' That framing makes the live-build and skill-repo posts legible to an audience that already knows the idea.

c_automation_pipelines.title: Herk Brain AI OS — local knowledge graph wired into a personal dashboard
c_automation_pipelines.creator: @nateherkai
c_automation_pipelines.what_it_teaches: A local-files 'AI OS' whose free GitHub repo 'interviews you and scaffolds the same setup'. The dashboard also surfaces 'YouTube comment trends'. 'An interview-driven setup repo is a good onboarding pattern for personal agents.'
c_automation_pipelines.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Copy the onboarding: make the open-source dejaviewed skill open with a 5-question interview (platforms, collections, public or private, theme). That lowers the barrier for GitHub visitors and makes a clean demo reel.

c_automation_pipelines.title: n8n + Veo 3 — Telegram-triggered AI vlog that auto-posts to YouTube
c_automation_pipelines.creator: @koen.agi
c_automation_pipelines.what_it_teaches: A Telegram message triggers an n8n flow that generates an eight-part story, renders each part with Veo 3, stitches it and uploads to YouTube. 'Telegram makes a convenient trigger for content pipelines.'
c_automation_pipelines.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Use the trigger pattern: text '/kit claude-code-hooks-system' to a Telegram bot, and n8n renders the kit (slides plus reel) and drops it in a review queue. That gives one-thumb publishing from the phone.

d_seo_aeo.title: llms.txt — get ChatGPT to recommend your local business
d_seo_aeo.creator: @brycenwood.ai
d_seo_aeo.what_it_teaches: A vehicle-wrap shop 'got ChatGPT to recommend' it via an llms.txt file describing business, location and value prop, 'built in 5min with Claude Code'.
d_seo_aeo.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: llms.txt and llms-full.txt are live already. The remaining step from primer.md is registering in llms.txt directories, and logging agent user-agents against /llms.txt to check whether it is used (the llms-txt-standard guide prescribes measuring).

d_seo_aeo.title: Jev keyword triage — score SERP beatability before writing content
d_seo_aeo.creator: @olivermerrick___
d_seo_aeo.what_it_teaches: Pull the top 10 results per keyword and have a classifier answer literal yes/no questions per result (intent, depth, freshness, site strength). 'Three or more weak top-10 results marks a winnable keyword'. 720 results cost about 4 cents.
d_seo_aeo.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Run it before choosing the next tool hubs and comparisons, since 22 hubs are noindex. Promote a noindex hub to indexed only when its keyword has 3 or more weak top-10 results. Search volume needs a separate tool.

d_seo_aeo.title: Agent Reach — open-source skill letting agents read Reddit and X
d_seo_aeo.creator: @itstundeanthony
d_seo_aeo.what_it_teaches: Agent Reach, an open-source skill, gives agents read access to 13 platforms without API costs. The demo shows Claude failing to fetch Reddit and X, then succeeding with comments.
d_seo_aeo.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Use it in the question-mining step: have Claude read r/ClaudeAI and related subreddits weekly for recurring questions that a guide already answers, which feeds the weekly question page and the Reddit seeding.

d_seo_aeo.title: Programmatic SEO in an hour a week — answer real questions with ChatGPT
d_seo_aeo.creator: @heytony.agency
d_seo_aeo.what_it_teaches: A weekly loop claimed at 14K visitors and 708 keywords: find a real question on findquestions.com, draft with ChatGPT, human edit, 'add images and three internal links', publish one post per week.
d_seo_aeo.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Make 'one question page a week' a standing job: pick a real question in a covered niche, answer it with the matching guide's 'In short' as the lead, and link 3 entries. Pages are server-rendered already, so they index cleanly.

d_seo_aeo.title: AI search citations — why your chatbot cites the 'unlocked web'
d_seo_aeo.creator: @wetclaude
d_seo_aeo.what_it_teaches: High-credibility sites block GPTBot and Common Crawl, so 'AI search reads only what's left', and 'one in six cited sources is AI-written'. AI cites self-ranking listicles.
d_seo_aeo.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Keep AI crawlers allowed (primer already says turn AI Labyrinth off). The /best and /compare pages are listicle-shaped, which is the format AI search cites. Make them verifiably sourced (entry links) to beat the AI-written listicles they compete with.

d_seo_aeo.title: AI Overview SEO — seeding social posts that Google and ChatGPT cite
d_seo_aeo.creator: @edward.builds
d_seo_aeo.what_it_teaches: A LinkedIn post was cited by Google's AI Overview the same day. 'AI answer engines lean heavily on UGC platforms for citations' (YouTube, Reddit, LinkedIn, X); 'put the target keyword at the start of the post'.
d_seo_aeo.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Seed each guide's 'In short' answer as a keyword-first LinkedIn post or Reddit comment linking to the guide, so answer engines find a citable UGC copy that points at the canonical page. The self-assertion gaming shown here is a reason to stay factual.

e_newsletter_email_community.title: DIY founder PR — agent-scraped journalist requests and tailored pitches
e_newsletter_email_community.creator: @angus.sewell
e_newsletter_email_community.what_it_teaches: An agent scrapes journalist request sites, pulls each journalist's last ten articles and drafts an angle close to what they already write. 'Short emails get more replies than long pitches'; 'give the model example emails so it doesn't sound like AI'; it is 'a volume game'.
e_newsletter_email_community.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Pitch the dataset angle (for example '28% of 846 AI-tool posts gate their content behind a comment') to AI newsletters and tech reporters. Backlinks from them help SEO and answer-engine trust.

e_newsletter_email_community.title: Trojan-horse marketplace — co-marketing with adjacent vendors via AI
e_newsletter_email_community.creator: @angus.sewell
e_newsletter_email_community.what_it_teaches: A YC growth tactic: spin up a marketplace, invite vendors selling to the same customers to be featured, offer generous affiliate splits ('10% to you, 20% to them'), and use the relationship for co-branded webinars and partnerships. 'A directory is a low-friction excuse to open partner conversations.'
e_newsletter_email_community.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: The 40 tool hubs are that directory. Email tool makers (n8n, Higgsfield, Runway, Kling) that they are featured with a verdict, and ask for a reshare or an affiliate approval. This doubles as the affiliate-activation outreach for the 25 pending /go/ programs.

e_newsletter_email_community.title: DIY media brand — agent-written features and carousels instead of paid press
e_newsletter_email_community.creator: @angus.sewell
e_newsletter_email_community.what_it_teaches: Instead of paying for press features, an agent DMs influencers offering features, rewrites their top posts into articles, then turns articles into Instagram carousels and pitches collabs. 'Repurpose one strong post into article plus carousel.'
e_newsletter_email_community.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: DejaViewed already features creators: 64 guides credit specific posts. DM or tag each credited creator when their guide's kit goes live ('your post anchors this guide'). Reshares from accounts like @chase.h.ai or @nateherkai are the fastest borrowed audience available.

f_monetization.title: Claude — Stop selling software. Sell the finished work.
f_monetization.creator: @tpadumke
f_monetization.what_it_teaches: An AI-native service loop: 'JobSpy MCP pulls listings from Indeed, LinkedIn, Google Jobs', Claude scores how automatable they are and writes the proposal, then agents handle the repetitive tasks via a Gmail routine. Claimed '20 clients × $400/mo = $8k MRR'.
f_monetization.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Lead sourcing for the done-for-you service behind /go/service: search for 'knowledge base', 'Notion cleanup', 'content repurposing' contract posts and score fit for a 'turn your saves/bookmarks into a searchable site' offer. The income figure is unverified.

f_monetization.title: Princeton sponsored-ads study — 18 of 23 AI assistants push the paid option
f_monetization.creator: @forgoodcode
f_monetization.what_it_teaches: A Princeton study: '18 of 23 favored the sponsored pick', GPT-5.1 surfaced it 94% of the time, and a 'serve the customer only' system prompt barely moved it. The creator notes it was a hypothetical setup.
f_monetization.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Positioning for the affiliate layer: 'verdicts written before any affiliate deal' plus the existing FTC label is a trust claim that AI assistants can't make. Put it on /about and /method.

f_monetization.title: Agentic OS — Claude Code as engine with Obsidian memory and skill packs
f_monetization.creator: @chase.h.ai
f_monetization.what_it_teaches: An 'agentic OS' with Claude Code as engine, Obsidian as memory, skill packs and a dashboard: 'package skills plus a dashboard as a deliverable for clients'.
f_monetization.how_to_apply_to_dejaviewed: Define the service SKU concretely: install the dejaviewed skill on a client's saves, deliver the site plus a skill pack. The public site is the portfolio piece.

Run a humanizer and StopSlop pass over the 63 kit captions before they go out, and make it a gate in content_kit.py (DbJzWBfxPvD, DcT15tflt4K).
Add the hook and slide constraints to scripts/content_templates: a 10-word hook cap, 12 words per tip slide, and a save/comment CTA on the last slide (DXmbF8lCDOP).

Open a Pinterest business account and pin the first 5 slides with search-phrased captions linking to guides (DZsEdvNoFdm).
Post 2 guide 'In short' answers keyword-first on LinkedIn and answer 3 matching Reddit questions with a guide link (DaEH4BJMxRX, DXzst1gxPeK).
Record 3 OpenScreen walkthroughs of indexed tool hubs (n8n, higgsfield, runway), voiced by Victor, for the first Keep/Try/Skip reels (DWl3Bo6jqX1, Dba75DDxiqc).
Install n8n-mcp and add Plausible, or another goal-tracking tool, so campaign referrers and /go/ clicks get attributed before the drip scales (DUzg0n1jRK-, DY-6VBpEgLS).
caveats: No newsletter or email tactics anywhere in the corpus. Nothing covers list building, lead magnets, Beehiiv/Substack or email cadence, and the site has no email capture (only feed.xml). A growth plan needs an owned channel, and this has to come from outside the archive.
No engagement data. The catalog has no view, like or save counts, so the outlier-hook method (DY7r-CjT0AD) only works after scraping metrics (Apify, DVmw74XEbk7) or once our own posts have data.

Platform-algorithm claims are anecdotal. The only Instagram growth 'cheat codes' entry (DXJ19sgjlhT) has an unrelated French transcript and no content. Advice like DYR6m86oBj_ is one creator's experience. TikTok and YouTube algorithm mechanics are absent.

Heavy sponsor bias in the video-gen tactics. Many of the Higgsfield/Seedance entries (DXKFrnQEfEQ, DXKani5jWFi, DXIpm6TjE5M, DcUsVlvpYYu, DdKEdJqF3QD) are promos with discount CTAs. Income claims ($8k MRR in DX4VJO6zMzL, $40K/month in DXzst1gxPeK, $30k in DcR6KUyPC0n) are unverified.
About 28% of entries (roughly 236 of 846 by a caption/transcript regex) gate their payload behind 'comment KEYWORD'. Many recommended repos and skills are unnamed, so they must be found or rebuilt.

Affiliate economics are not in the corpus. All 25 /go/ programs in data/monetize/affiliates.json are 'pending', and approval terms and commission rates come from data/monetize/affiliates_research.json, not the archive.

Rights and credit. Carousels built from creators' posts need credit and should paraphrase, not re-host their video. The corpus has no guidance on repost rights or Instagram's original-content ranking.

Avoid the black- and grey-hat tactics present in the archive. Expired-domain rebuilds (DdQD_N6Nhz2) carry manual-penalty risk, self-assertion AI-Overview gaming (DaEH4BJMxRX) can backfire, and fully synthetic AI-influencer funnels (DdXyLUWTJ4Z, DboDjfgkVOG) are ethically and legally murky.

Automation costs. Since the June 15 change, headless claude -p and Agent SDK runs bill per token outside Pro/Max limits (DYXWNTERFhZ), so scheduled content agents carry API cost. Video generation burns credits fast (DawRY1kJ_ch, DYiiwmzpRM7).

Measurement is thin today. The site has Cloudflare path analytics only: no scroll depth, no conversion goals for /go/service, and no per-campaign attribution. The analytics entries are mostly sponsored PostHog posts (DdHJn-ZRpbd, Dcl1xrTIf5V, DZGC7HXtr1f).

Paid distribution such as the clipping economy at about $1-1.50 per thousand views (DadfHYrkmr7, DdZz4DfNzNW) and Meta ads agents (DcR6KUyPC0n, Db36X9ZypwK) needs budget and hard spend caps. It is not a fit until organic posts identify a winner.
